copy.headline: Tarrant County to mark 25 years of celebrating National Adoption Day
copy.caption:
The county joins 400-plus U.S. communities in helping to raise awareness of over 100,000 children waiting to be adopted from foster care. By her best estimates, LaTonya Green has parented about 75 children.

The 59-year-old southwest Arlington hairstylist has known since she was a teenage mother that she wanted to spend her life helping children. In the decades since, most of them came to her home for a period of months or years and then moved on to other phases of their lives.

story.summary: The county joins 400-plus U.S. communities in helping to raise awareness of over 100,000 children waiting to be adopted from foster care. Enjoy reading the news again. Join over 110,000 neighbors who count on our newsletters for stories happening in your backyard. Sign up for free . By her best estimates, LaTonya Green has parented about 75 children. The 59-year-old southwest Arlington hairstylist has known since she was a teenage mother that she wanted to spend her life helping children. In the decades since, most of them came to her home for a period of months or years and then moved on to other phases of their lives. But a few times, the bond she formed with a child became lifelong and official.
